name: Service
overview: Service in Scripture reflects a Christ-centered calling to humble, selfless action for others, modeled supremely by Jesus who came not to be served but to serve and give His life for many (Mark 10:45). Genuine service involves meeting the needs of the hungry, thirsty, and stranger, demonstrating love to Christ Himself through practical compassion (Isaiah 58:10; Matthew 25:35). True leadership in God's kingdom is defined by a servant's heart, where those who desire to be first must become servants of all (Mark 9:35). Serving Christ requires devotion and following His example, promising honor from the Father to those who faithfully serve Him (John 12:26; Romans 12:11).
